title: Fix proxy script for machines in rootless mode
body:
This PR has 3 commits:
- The first "[Fix proxyenv unit tests on Windows and run them with winmake](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30323/changes/4b07e17d9e12d81d0c95c83f72e195b7f240789c)" fixes the proxyenv unit test on Windows and enables it in winmake.ps1 (so that CI executes it)
- The second "[Fix proxy script for machines in rootless mode](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30323/changes/c0e274d9d67666a7279f413a2042f5d527e3fa82)" is the main commit of the PR and fixes the script that sets the proxy in a Podman machine that wasn't reloading the user systemd manager (and proxy settings were effective only when a machine was restarted a second time). I have noticed that while looking at #30292 
- The third "[Skip systemd reloads at machine start when no proxy is set](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30323/changes/0a5cbd0b9b424444f739857abacabb2c106f40f0)" avoids reloading systemd when proxy env variables aren't set and makes the machine startup ~1s faster.
